answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and isolated to the primary region during peak settlement writes. Compliance forbids reverting the security patch, so rollback is unavailable. Circuit breaking (memory_b4) fails requests and conflicts with not losing customer writes. Read-replica routing (memory_b5) was for report/read offload, which is not the stated load. memory_b3 is pre-peak headroom, a weaker match to an already-regional write degradation. memory_b2 is the closest analog (regional failover restored latency with a clean shift). Intending regional failover at full scope because this is the only intervention this window. Verifying b2 and b3: the same build may exist in the target region, and capacity is the main alternative that would not drop writes. Mid-peak write failover can affect settlement completeness, so downstream value risk is flagged. Cause (regional infra vs write amplification from the patch) is not uniquely identified.
